_about: Public-domain Ezekiel Hopkins (1634-1690, Bishop of Raphoe and then of Derry) for the Word Hoard: the Works (Philadelphia: Leighton Publications, ed. Charles W. Quick from Pratt's London edition, 3 vols; Princeton's shelfmarks date the scanned copies 1867 and 1874), raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton scans. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 7 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
